name: gestão de confecção
install:
set -euo pipefail
cd /workspace
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  echo "[install] No package.json at /workspace on this revision; skipping npm install."
  exit 0
fi
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
else
  npm install --no-audit --no-fund
fi
start:
set -euo pipefail
cd /workspace
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  echo "[start] No package.json at /workspace; nothing to start."
  exit 0
fi
if [ ! -d node_modules ]; then
  if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; else npm install --no-audit --no-fund; fi
fi
has_dev=$(node -p "require('./package.json').scripts && require('./package.json').scripts.dev ? 'yes' : 'no'")
if [ "$has_dev" != "yes" ]; then
  echo "[start] No npm dev script; skipping servers."
  exit 0
fi
if curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health >/dev/null || curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/health >/dev/null; then
  echo "[start] API already running."
  exit 0
fi
nohup npm run dev >/tmp/gestao-dev.log 2>&1 &
echo $! >/tmp/gestao-dev.pid
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health >/dev/null || curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/health >/dev/null; then
    echo "[start] API is ready."
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 1
done
echo "[start] Timed out waiting for API. See /tmp/gestao-dev.log" >&2
exit 1
